svg.title: RL_PID — reinforcement-learning-tuned PID control
svg.desc: Final-year project in control systems: a PPO agent retunes a PID controller online to control the unstable process G(s) = 1/(s − 1). On the step test it beats the published m-PPO agent on all four metrics (mean of 3 seeds): overshoot 57.8 to 32.0 percent, settling 1.70 to 1.37 s, ISE 0.142 to 0.127, IAE 0.266 to 0.256. The trained controller also runs on an STM32F407.
